| description = Spawns if a [[Ry`Gorr Emissary]] is left alone after he spawns at the small tower outside the Ry'Gorr Fort. Despawns when the Emissary walks away so you must engage before this happens. [[Ry`Gorr Emissary]] will not agro/social if you tag Rodrick from a distance. Drops two [[Coldain Ring Quests|Coldain Ring quest]] items, one for #6 and another for #9. Was able to land Pox of Bertoxxulous and Envenomed Bolt without issue. Couldn't land root or slow. About a 6 minute 30 second respawn on the Emissary that spawns Rodrick.

The script can become bugged. If the Emissary is up and staring at an empty hut for more than a minute you need to kill it and let it respawn, upon which the script will reset and spawn Rodrick.
